title: Coffee Can Investing: The Low Risk Route to Stupendous Wealth
whyItMatters: Presents an empirical framework for Indian public equity selection based on ROCE > 15% and revenue growth > 10% sustained over a decade.
keyTakeaways: Survivorship and clean accounts filter removes 90% of BSE listed universe
Long-term buy-and-hold reduces portfolio churn and frictional transaction costs
Power of compounding in Indian consumer monopolies

title: The Unusual Billionaires
whyItMatters: In-depth case studies of Indian corporate champions (Asian Paints, Marico, HDFC Bank, Astral Poly) that built durable moats.
keyTakeaways: Competitive moats in distribution, IT supply chain, and brand recall
Capital allocation discipline during cyclical downturns
Promoter integrity and capital efficiency

title: Diamonds in the Dust: Consistent Compounding for Extraordinary Wealth Creation
whyItMatters: Essential guide on forensic accounting checklists to detect Indian corporate manipulation and creative accounting.
keyTakeaways: Auditor rotation, related-party transactions, and contingent liabilities
Cash flow conversion vs reported accounting EBITDA
Evaluating management capital reinvestment quality

title: Bulls, Bears and Other Beasts: A Story of the Indian Stock Market
whyItMatters: Fictionalized biographical account capturing the post-liberalization history of Dalal Street, from open outcry to screen trading.
keyTakeaways: Cyclical mania and panics across 1992, 2000 tech bubble, and 2008 Lehman crisis
Operator syndicates, circular trading, and retail traps
Evolution of SEBI regulatory surveillance

title: The Scam: Who Won, Who Lost, Who Got Away
whyItMatters: The definitive investigative journalism account of the 1992 Harshad Mehta securities scam.
keyTakeaways: How Bank Receipts (BRs) and inter-bank ready-forward deals were misused
Collusion between public sector banks and stock brokers
Catalyzed the creation of modern electronic depositories (NSDL/CDSL) and SEBI empowerment

title: The Intelligent Investor
whyItMatters: The timeless foundational text on value investing, the concept of Margin of Safety, and Mr. Market psychology.
keyTakeaways: Distinction between investment and speculation
Defensive vs enterprising investor allocation frameworks
Emotional detachment from market fluctuations

title: The Psychology of Money: Timeless lessons on wealth, greed, and happiness
whyItMatters: Argues that doing well with money has a little to do with how smart you are and a lot to do with how you behave.
keyTakeaways: Wealth is what you do not see (saved capital rather than consumed items)
Room for error (margin of safety) is the most critical component of financial plans
Compounding only works when you give an asset un-interrupted time

title: The Bogleheads' Guide to Investing
whyItMatters: The bible of low-cost broad index investing, simplicity in personal finance, and keeping investment expenses minimal.
keyTakeaways: Costs matter enormously over decades due to expense drag
Asset allocation drives over 90% of portfolio return variability
Market timing is mathematically futile for retail investors

title: Let's Talk Money: You've Worked Hard for It, Now Make It Work for You
whyItMatters: The most practical, grounded cash-flow system designed specifically for Indian salaried professionals.
keyTakeaways: Three-bank-account cash-flow automation system (Income, Spend, Invest)
Strict separation of insurance from investment (avoiding traditional endowment/money-back traps)
Building a medical contingency shield before entering equity

title: Let's Talk Mutual Funds: A Systematic, Smart Way to Wealth
whyItMatters: Navigates the Indian mutual fund landscape, decoding SEBI categories, debt fund risks, and goal-based portfolios.
keyTakeaways: Selecting funds based on asset class rather than recent 1-year returns
SIP, STP, and SWP mechanics for accumulation and distribution
Direct plans vs regular plans mathematically computed

title: What Every Indian Should Know Before Investing
whyItMatters: Comprehensive primer on Indian statutory instruments: EPF, PPF, NPS, Sovereign Gold Bonds, and Real Estate.
keyTakeaways: Tax efficiency under Old vs New Tax Regimes
Understanding sovereign small savings scheme rules and lock-ins
Common pitfalls in buying property on debt

title: Expected Returns: An Investor's Guide to Harvesting Market Rewards
whyItMatters: Comprehensive academic and practitioner synthesis of historical risk premiums across equities, fixed income, credit, and alternative factors.
keyTakeaways: Equity risk premium, term premium, credit spread, and liquidity premium dynamics
Factor premiums: Value, Momentum, Carry, and Volatility
Managing expectations and avoiding recency bias
